## Appendix A: The Complete 2024–2028 Pool (sample)

Every question below is quoted verbatim from the 2024–2028 Extra pool, with the correct answer marked and a one-line why pointing at the chapter that teaches it.

> **E1A01** Which frequency segment is reserved exclusively for Amateur Extra class licensees?
> A. The entire 80 meter band
> B. 14.100 MHz to 14.150 MHz
> C. All frequencies above 30 MHz
> D. The 60 meter channels
> **Answer: B** — Extra-only segments sit at the band edges (chapter 1).

> **E1A03** What is the maximum bandwidth for a data emission on the 20 meter band?
> A. 2.8 kHz
> B. 300 hertz
> C. 19.6 kHz
> D. 56 kHz
> **Answer: A** — the HF data bandwidth limit is 2.8 kHz (chapter 1).
